Speaker: Village Elder
Text: Kael. You're really going through with this. I can see it in your eyes.

Speaker: Kael
Text: I need the Harmonic Crystal. Ashcroft's notes say there's one at Cogspire Academy.

Speaker: Village Elder
Text: Cogspire... yes. Professor Venn was Ashcroft's colleague. If anyone has the crystal, it's him.

Speaker: Village Elder
Text: But be careful. The Ironclad Authority has eyes everywhere. They don't want anyone crossing the Rift.
